title: What kind of build is this?

milestone.title: Visual Studio and the Build Pipeline

description:
Print facts about the build from predefined macros.

```
compiler: MSVC 19.40
configuration: Debug (_DEBUG defined)
platform: x64 (_WIN64)
C++ standard: 202302
```
hints: `_MSC_VER` is a number like `1940`; the major version is `_MSC_VER / 100` (lesson 4.02).
MSVC reports `__cplusplus` correctly only with `/Zc:__cplusplus`; use `_MSVC_LANG` too.
requirements: Print a line for each, with "not defined" where it is missing.
Build it in Debug and Release and compare.
stretch: Print the build date and time with `__DATE__` and `__TIME__`.
